features.name: Public benchmark score (R@5 or equivalent)

values.gbrain: R@5 95% (hybrid+graph) vs 83% baseline em BrainBench 240-page Opus corpus

features.delta: mempalace e mem0 reportam em benchmarks publicos padroes (LongMemEval/LoCoMo); gbrain reporta em dataset proprio; gsd-2 nao tem benchmark publico

features.name: Eval harness incluso

values.gbrain: yes (src/core/search/eval.ts + gbrain eval com P@k, R@k, MRR, nDCG)

features.delta: gsd-2 e o unico sem eval harness dedicado

features.name: Documented p50/p99 latency

values.gbrain: no p50/p99 explicito para write/query; statement_timeout scoping no Postgres
values.mem0: latency p50 reportada em benchmarks (0.88s LoCoMo, 1.09s LongMemEval, end-to-end)

features.delta: mem0 publica p50 end-to-end; mempalace declara budgets; gbrain/gsd-2 nao expoem

features.name: Batch/async write support

values.gbrain: yes (addLinksBatch, addTimelineEntriesBatch via unnest; Minions job queue durable background)
values.mempalace: incremental only (append-only), sem batch explicito documentado
values.gsd-2: memory writes sync em SQLite (single-writer invariant)

features.delta: gbrain tem batch + job queue durable; mem0 tem async; mempalace e gsd-2 sincronos

features.name: Storage strategy

values.gbrain: paraphrase-first (compiled_truth primario, raw em raw_data JSONB)
values.gsd-2: structured fields (categoria + content) per memory row

features.delta: MemPalace e o unico com verbatim-only como principio de design; gbrain/mem0 paraphrasam; gsd-2 usa categorias rigidas

features.name: Durable backend

values.gbrain: yes (PGLite WASM Postgres ou Supabase Postgres)
values.mem0: yes (Qdrant + Neo4j via docker-compose ou hosted)

features.delta: Todos tem backend durable; difere apenas a tecnologia

features.name: Schema model

values.gbrain: pages + chunks + links + timeline (schema rigido mas extensivel via frontmatter JSONB)
values.mempalace: drawers schemaless + entity registry + typed predicates na KG
values.mem0: memories com metadata flexivel + entity linking + graph (Neo4j)
values.gsd-2: memory rows com categoria enum (architecture/convention/gotcha/preference/environment/pattern) + structured_fields JSON

features.delta: mempalace e mem0 tem schema mais flexivel (metadata + entity types); gbrain fixa page types; gsd-2 fixa categorias

features.name: Zero API keys no core path

values.gbrain: NO (OpenAI embeddings padrao obrigatorio pra embed/search)
values.mempalace: YES (raw 96.6% R@5 sem LLM em nenhum estagio, zero API keys)
values.mem0: NO (OpenAI default LLM+embedding, PostHog telemetry core)
values.gsd-2: Depende (Pi SDK pode rodar via Ollama; memory core SQLite local)

features.delta: Apenas mempalace roda core path sem nenhuma API key; gbrain e mem0 dependem de OpenAI; gsd-2 e hibrido

features.name: Telemetry default

values.gbrain: no telemetry detectado nas deps core
values.mem0: posthog em deps core (telemetry on by default)
values.gsd-2: RTK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 forced; sem telemetria no core memory

features.delta: mem0 e o unico com telemetria default on; mempalace tem politica explicita zero-telemetry

features.name: Works offline

values.gbrain: parcial (PGLite local, mas embedding requer OpenAI)
values.gsd-2: parcial (Ollama possivel via extension; memory local)

features.delta: Apenas mempalace tem caminho 100% offline documentado

features.name: Embedding providers

values.mempalace: 1 default (ChromaDB default ~300MB model); pluggable via backend
values.mem0: 15 providers (OpenAI, Azure, Gemini, HF, FastEmbed, Together, Bedrock, Ollama, VertexAI, ...)

features.delta: mem0 domina vastamente (15 providers); gbrain e mempalace usam um default; gsd-2 deriva do Pi SDK

features.name: Vector store flexibility

values.mem0: 30 vector stores (Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, Milvus, MongoDB, Redis, ES, pgvector, Supabase, Faiss, ...)

features.delta: mem0 tem 30 stores, lider absoluto; gbrain 2 engines Postgres; mempalace 1 default pluggable; gsd-2 fixa SQLite

features.name: Knowledge graph native

values.gbrain: YES self-wiring sem LLM (typed edges: attended/works_at/invested_in/founded/advises/source/mentions), 3+ hop traversal via gbrain graph-query
values.mempalace: YES temporal KG (SQLite; entities + typed predicates + valid_from/valid_to)
values.mem0: YES graph memory layer opcional (Neo4j/Memgraph/Kuzu/AGE externo)
values.gsd-2: YES memory relations graph (Phase 4), memories linkam feed planning

values.mem0: entity extraction via LLM batch + entity linking multi-signal

features.delta: gbrain unico com zero-LLM auto-linking; mempalace e mem0 usam extracao; gsd-2 depende do caller LLM

values.mem0: YES (9 MCP tools via openmemory + mem0-plugin)
